name: Parallel Compositing
aliases: Parallel Compositing — Fragment Compositing, MPI Alltoallv Compositing
definition: A parallel compositing stage that partitions final image pixels across tasks, exchanges fragments generated in the raycasting phase to the task owning the fragment's image region, performs final compositing using the 'over' operator, and gathers the final image on the root task.
summary: Parallel Compositing partitions images into tiles and uses MPI_Alltoallv to exchange ray-casting fragments for local compositing, differing from other methods by its reliance on this collective communication pattern.
